2026-11-07T10:00:36.119Z.name: BASC Auction Token
2026-11-07T10:00:36.119Z.description: The official new utility token of the BCH After School Club, a very chill study club under the Supreme Student Council (2026-2027) at AMA Computer College - Naga Campus. BAT features an expanded 100M total supply (upgraded from the original 102,026 supply AFTER token). It holds no monetary value and is minted primarily to give students hands-on exposure on the Bitcoin Cash network. Members earn $BAT (which acts like point rewards) by attending weekly after-school study sessions and completing quick BCH quizzes, then use their accumulated tokens to bid in monthly budget-meal auction game.
